text:
maya: Quick heads-up — two pilot customers put their Dedicated go-live on hold. blocker: no concise route-level economics nor compact error slices. Need a small unblock this quarter. :grimacing:

tony: Agree we should scope a narrow ship. Proposal: per-route 24h cost table + error-rate small-multiples + a "view trace" link that opens sampled traces. No span histograms in v1. Est: 3 dev days + 2 infra days + docs.

ben: Attribution risk noted. Can we live on nightly batch attribution with an expected ~10% variance for high-volume routes? If yes, saves a week. If not, need route propagation through billing tags which is heavier.

maya: Acceptance for MVP-A: (1) route cost numbers within 10% of offline baseline for top routes; (2) route error-rate signal stable for 24h; (3) docs/runbook + one customer signoff. Owners: @tony impl, @ben infra, @sarah customer validation, @maya comms/docs.

emma: Pilots asked for a simple "what-if" slider to demo batching/quantization impact per-route. They said it's a nice-to-have for first demo but a must-have later. Mark as stretch.

tony: Sampling plan: deterministic reservoir per-route + sticky sample_id so traces across services correlate. Spike: 2d to validate bias. I'll post a gist with the pseudo-code tonight. Eg: ```sample_id = hash(route_id, request_id) % reservoir_size```

ben: Infra asks: ephemeral validation pipeline (1-2 weeks) and a small billing-tag to carry route_id. Ops gave tentative thumbs-up once a ticket exists. I'll open INF ticket and request ephemeral instance.

devex-bot: Reminder — add a brief feature blurb to SDK changelog and update release notes template. (action: @maya)

sarah: I'll schedule two 30-min customer acceptance sessions and draft pass/fail scenarios. We should include a short checklist: data freshness, cost delta vs nightly, and trace link verification.

maya: Proposed split: MVP-A = cost table + error sparkline + trace link (pilot beta). MVP-B = what-if slider + sampling controls + richer error buckets. Target MVP-A for sprint 12.

ton y: Spike card created (#6123). If reuse of nightly attribution works, impl drops to ~3 dev-days. If not, +4d for tag propagation work.

ben: Cards + infra ticket filed, tagging billing and ops. Requesting ephemeral R5 for validation window.

maya: Next sync Thurs 9am to finalize acceptance tests. Action items summary in issue: tony (sampling spike + impl), ben (infra ticket + ephemeral), sarah (customer sessions), maya (docs + release blurb), emma (stakeholder comms). Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
